entities.name: sacubitril/valsartan
observations: Neprilysin inhibition can increase circulating BNP or complicate its interpretation; NT-proBNP is not a neprilysin substrate and is generally preferred for monitoring after initiation.

entities.name: ARNI raises BNP
observations: In heart failure, sacubitril inhibits BNP degradation, so BNP may rise despite clinical stability; NT-proBNP is not directly affected by neprilysin inhibition.

entities.name: PMID:27501171
observations: Abstract reports miR-221 overexpression in 5-FU-resistant esophageal cancer cell lines and human EAC tissue; DKK2 identified as a miR-221 target. miR-221 knockdown restored chemosensitivity and altered DKK2/Wnt-β-catenin signaling.

entities.name: miR-221
observations: In the 2016 EAC study, miR-221 was elevated in 5-FU-resistant models; knockdown restored chemosensitivity and the authors concluded it acts partly through direct DKK2 targeting.

entities.name: DKK2
observations: Identified as a miR-221 target in the 2016 esophageal cancer study; altered DKK2 expression was implicated in Wnt/β-catenin pathway changes after miR-221 knockdown.

entities.name: Esophageal adenocarcinoma
observations: The study used EAC cell models, including 5-FU-resistant variants, and human EAC tissues.

entities.name: miR-221 5-FU resistance
observations: In resistant esophageal cancer cell models, miR-221 knockdown reduced proliferation, increased apoptosis, restored 5-FU chemosensitivity, and changed DKK2/Wnt-β-catenin signaling; the abstract does not specify the direct-binding assay.
